```{r, "old get_EF_list function", eval=FALSE}
get_EF_list <- function(obj_list = meta_table_list,
                                  id_col        = "gene",
                                  metric_col = "median_log2FC",
                                  base_map      = c(
                                    "NK"          = "NKs",
                                    "monocytes"   = "Monocytes",
                                    "B_cells"     = "B Cells",
                                    "CD4_T_cells" = "CD4+ T Cells",
                                    "CD8_T_cells" = "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                  cell_order    = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells",
                                                    "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                  filter_nocoding = TRUE,
                              
                              list_of_overlaps = list(
                                "All Five" = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                "Exclude NKs" = c("Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                "Exclude Monocytes" = c("NKs", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                "Exclude B Cells" = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                "Exclude CD4+ T Cells" = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD8+ T Cells"),
                                "Exclude CD8+ T Cells" = c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells")),
                              thresholds_list = list(
                                "Positive DE" = list("median_log2FC" = 1.25, "q_val_fisher" = 0.05, "Positive" = TRUE),
                                "Negative DE" = list("median_log2FC" = 1.25, "q_val_fisher" = 0.05, "Positive" = FALSE)
                                )
                              
                              ){
  
  #calculate rho_list
  {
    
    rho_metric <- build_metric_df_for_fold_change(
      obj_list = obj_list,
      id_col        = id_col,
      metric_col = metric_col,
      base_map      = base_map,
      cell_order    = cell_order,
      filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
    ) 
    
    
    # df = your tibble (rho_metric). First col is gene, others are stats.
    S <- rho_metric %>% dplyr::select(-gene)
    
    # 1) get all pairwise combos of columns
    pairs <- combn(colnames(S), 2, simplify = FALSE)
    
    # 2) compute Spearman r and turn into rho (= 1 + r_s) if you want that mapping
    rho_df <- map_dfr(
      pairs,
      ~{
        a <- .x[1]; b <- .x[2]
        r_s  <- suppressWarnings(cor(S[[a]], S[[b]], method = "spearman", use = "pairwise.complete.obs"))
        tibble(
          cell1 = a,
          cell2 = b,
          r_s   = r_s,
          rho   = 1 + r_s     # drop this or change mapping if you just want r_s
        )
      }
    )
    
    #Helper function to calculate the geometric mean of rhos
    geom_mean_rho <- function(rho_vec, na.rm = TRUE) {
      if (any(rho_vec <= 0, na.rm = na.rm)) {
        stop("All rho values must be > 0 for a geometric mean.")
      }
      exp(mean(log(rho_vec), na.rm = na.rm))
    }
    
    #Calculate final rho for each overlap of cells provided
    rho_list <- imap(
      list_of_overlaps,
      ~{
        subset_cells <- .x
        rho_vec <- rho_df %>%
          filter(cell1 %in% subset_cells, cell2 %in% subset_cells) %>%
          pull(rho)
        geom_mean_rho(rho_vec)
      }
    )
    
  }
  
  #Create filtered_obj_list and filtered_intersection_list
  {
    
    #filtered_obj_list: Filter obj_list to include only DE genes
    {
      ## --- sanity checks -----------------------------------------------------------
      stopifnot(is.list(obj_list), length(obj_list) > 0)
      needed_cols <- c("median_log2FC", "q_val_fisher")
      stopifnot(all(map_lgl(obj_list, ~all(needed_cols %in% names(.x)))))
      
      check_thr <- function(thr){
        stopifnot(is.list(thr),
                  all(c("median_log2FC","q_val_fisher","Positive") %in% names(thr)),
                  is.numeric(thr$median_log2FC), thr$median_log2FC > 0,
                  is.numeric(thr$q_val_fisher),  thr$q_val_fisher  > 0,
                  is.logical(thr$Positive),      length(thr$Positive)==1)
      }
      invisible(walk(thresholds_list, check_thr))
      
      ## --- helper -----------------------------------------------------------
      filter_one_df <- function(df, thr){
        fc_ok <- if (thr$Positive) df$median_log2FC >=  thr$median_log2FC
        else               df$median_log2FC <= -thr$median_log2FC
        q_ok  <- df$q_val_fisher <= thr$q_val_fisher
        df %>% filter(fc_ok & q_ok)
      }
      
      ## --- main --------------------------------------------------------------
      filtered_obj_list <- imap(thresholds_list, ~{
        thr <- .x
        map(obj_list, filter_one_df, thr = thr)
      })
    }
    
    filtered_intersection_list <- purrr::imap(
      filtered_obj_list,
      ~ build_presence_df(
        obj_list        = .x,
        id_col          = id_col,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        base_map    = base_map,
        cell_order  = cell_order
      )
    )
    
    
    
  }
  
  #Calculate E0_list
  {

    
    #rename the meta tables inside filtered_obj_list
    {
      rename_inner <- function(x){
        old_core <- str_remove(names(x), "_meta_table$")
        new_nm   <- base_map[old_core]
        if (any(is.na(new_nm)))
          stop("Some names in inner list not found in base_map.")
        set_names(x, new_nm)
      }
      
      filtered_obj_list <- lapply(filtered_obj_list, rename_inner)
    }
    
    #E0_list
    {
      ## ---- 1. helper: E0 for a given subset of cells -------------------------------
      ## k_i = #rows (DE genes) in each cell df
      ## N   = size of the tested protein-coding universe (e.g. nrow(rho_metric))
      compute_E0 <- function(cell_subset, cell_df_list, N) {
        stopifnot(all(cell_subset %in% names(cell_df_list)))
        k <- vapply(cell_subset, \(nm) nrow(cell_df_list[[nm]]), integer(1))
        prod(k) / N^(length(k) - 1)
      }
      
      ## ---- 2. build E0_list --------------------------------------------------------
      ## Inputs assumed to exist:
      ##   filtered_obj_list  (outer: "Positive DE","Negative DE"; inner: 5 dfs)
      ##   list_of_overlaps   (your named list of character vectors)
      ##   rho_metric         (or any object to get N from)
      N <- nrow(rho_metric)  # common universe size
      
      E0_list <- purrr::imap(filtered_obj_list, \(cell_df_list, thr_name) {
        purrr::imap(list_of_overlaps, \(cells, overlap_name) {
          compute_E0(cells, cell_df_list, N)
        })
      })
    }

  }
  
  #calculate x_list
  {
    count_overlap <- function(df, cols) {
      stopifnot(all(cols %in% names(df)))
      sum(rowSums(df[cols]) == length(cols), na.rm = TRUE)
    }
    
    # build x_list
    x_list <- imap(filtered_intersection_list, \(df_top, top_name) {
      imap(list_of_overlaps, \(cols, sub_name) count_overlap(df_top, cols))
    })
    
  }

  #Calculate EF_list
  {
    stopifnot(
      all(names(x_list)  == names(E0_list)),
      all(sort(names(rho_list)) == sort(names(list_of_overlaps)))
    )
    
    EF_list <- imap(x_list, \(x_sub, top_nm) {
      imap(x_sub, \(x_val, ov_nm) {
        E0  <- E0_list[[top_nm]][[ov_nm]]
        rho <- rho_list[[ov_nm]]
        x_val / (E0 * rho)
      })
    })
  }
    
  
}
```

```{r, "old get_intersection_composition_barplot function", eval=FALSE}
get_intersection_composition_barplot <- function(
    comp_df,   # output of get_intersection_composition_df
    cell_cols   = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    group_cols  = c("Immune_percent","Metabolism_percent","Stress_percent","Other_percent"),
    group_palette = c(
      Immune_percent     = "#fb8500",
      Metabolism_percent = "#219ebc",
      Stress_percent     = "#ffb703",
      Other_percent      = "#023047"
    ),           
    cell_order_mat   = c("Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells","B Cells","NKs"),
    title            = "Intersection Composition (Inclusive)",
    title_size        = 12,
    y_title_size      = 12,
    y_text_size       = 12,
    mat_row_text_size = 12,
    legend_title_size = 12,
    legend_text_size  = 12,
    base_size         = 12,
    heights           = c(3, 1.3)
){
  
  ## ── sanity checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  req_pkgs <- c("dplyr","tidyr","ggplot2","patchwork","forcats","tibble")
  miss <- req_pkgs[!vapply(req_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
  if (length(miss)) stop("Missing packages: ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
  
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(comp_df))
  miss_cells  <- setdiff(cell_cols,  names(comp_df))
  miss_groups <- setdiff(group_cols, names(comp_df))
  if (length(miss_cells))  stop("Missing cell columns: ", paste(miss_cells, collapse=", "))
  if (length(miss_groups)) stop("Missing group % columns: ", paste(miss_groups, collapse=", "))
  if (!"intersection_num" %in% names(comp_df))
    stop("comp_df must contain 'intersection_num'.")
  
  ## build label correctly -----------------------------------------------
  make_lab <- function(v) {
    hits <- cell_cols[which(v)]
    if (!length(hits)) "None" else paste(hits, collapse = " ∩ ")
  }

  comp_df <- comp_df %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      name = apply(dplyr::select(., dplyr::all_of(cell_cols)) |> as.matrix(), 1, make_lab)
    )
  
  ## order factor (unique levels!)
  ord <- comp_df %>%
    dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(intersection_num), dplyr::across(dplyr::all_of(cell_cols))) %>%
    dplyr::pull(name) %>%
    unique()
  
  ## ── BAR DATA (stacked to 100%) ────────────────────────────────────────────
  
  
  pdat <- comp_df %>%
    dplyr::select(name, dplyr::all_of(group_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(group_cols),
                        names_to = "group",
                        values_to = "percent") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(
      name  = factor(name, levels = ord),          # no more duplicated level error
      group = factor(group, levels = group_cols)
    )
  
  p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(pdat, ggplot2::aes(x = name, y = percent, fill = group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = group_palette, name = "Category") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = c(0, .05)), limits = c(0,100)) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      x = NULL,
      y = "Percent of genes",
      title = title
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = title_size),
      axis.title.y       = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
      axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size),
      axis.text.x        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      legend.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank()
    )
  
  ## ── INTERSECTION MATRIX (reuse logic, minimal changes) ─────────────────────
  cells <- cell_order_mat
  y_map <- tibble::tibble(cell = cells,
                          y_num = length(cells):1)
  
  mat_long <- comp_df %>%
    dplyr::select(name, dplyr::all_of(cell_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = dplyr::all_of(cell_cols),
                        names_to = "cell", values_to = "present") %>%
    dplyr::mutate(name = factor(name, levels = ord)) %>%
    dplyr::left_join(y_map, by = "cell")
  
  seg_df <- mat_long %>%
    dplyr::filter(present) %>%
    dplyr::group_by(name) %>%
    dplyr::summarise(ymin = min(y_num), ymax = max(y_num), .groups = "drop")
  
  p_mat <- ggplot2::ggplot(mat_long, ggplot2::aes(x = name, y = y_num)) +
    ggplot2::geom_segment(data = seg_df,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = name, xend = name, y = ymin, yend = ymax),
                          inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 0.4, colour = "black") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(ggplot2::aes(fill = present),
                        shape = 21, size = 2.8, colour = "black", stroke = 0.25) +
    ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(values = c(`TRUE` = "black", `FALSE` = "grey85"), guide = "none") +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_map$y_num, labels = y_map$cell) +
    ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = NULL) +
    ggplot2::theme_void(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      axis.text.y  = ggplot2::element_text(size = mat_row_text_size),
      axis.text.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      axis.ticks.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin  = ggplot2::margin(t = 0)
    )
  
  ## ── COMBINE ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  p_final <- p_bar / p_mat + patchwork::plot_layout(heights = heights)
  return(p_final)
}
```

```{r, "old get_intersection_composition_stack_barplot function", eval=FALSE}



get_intersection_composition_stack_barplot <- function(
    df,
    cell_cols    = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    percent_cols = c("Immune_percent","Metabolism_percent",
                     "Proteins_Metabolism_percent","RNA_Metabolism_percent",
                     "Other_percent"),
    group_name_map   = NULL,    # named vector: old_name = "Pretty name"
    group_palette    = NULL,    # named vector: "Pretty name" = "#hex"
    legend_title     = "Category",
    plot_title       = NULL,    # title for the stacked barplot
    x_title          = "Intersection",
    y_title          = "Percent",
    x_angle          = 45,
    x_hjust          = 1,
    x_order          = NULL,    # optional vector to set the order of the bars
    group_order      = NULL,    # character vector: stacking / legend order
    ## ── matrix args ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    list_of_overlaps = NULL,    # named list: names = column titles, values = character vectors of cells
    cell_order_mat   = c("Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells","B Cells","NKs"),
    heights          = c(3, 1.3),  # relative heights barplot / matrix
    base_size        = 12,
    mat_row_text_size = 12,
    ## ── reference line ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
    y_line           = NULL,    # if numeric, draw dashed line at this y and include it in y-axis breaks
    ## ── style sizes to match get_overlap_genes_significance_barplot ──────────
    title_size        = 16,
    y_title_size      = 14,
    y_text_size       = 14,
    legend_title_size = 14,
    legend_text_size  = 14
){
  ## ── sanity checks ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  stopifnot(is.data.frame(df))
  miss_cells   <- setdiff(cell_cols, names(df))
  miss_percent <- setdiff(percent_cols, names(df))
  if (length(miss_cells))   stop("Missing cell columns: ",   paste(miss_cells, collapse = ", "))
  if (length(miss_percent)) stop("Missing percent columns: ",paste(miss_percent, collapse = ", "))
  
  ## ── readable intersection labels ───────────────────────────────────────────
  intersection_lbl <- apply(df[cell_cols], 1, function(x){
    paste(cell_cols[as.logical(x)], collapse = " ∩ ")
  })
  df <- df %>% dplyr::mutate(.intersection = intersection_lbl)
  
  ## ── long format ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  long_df <- df %>% 
    dplyr::select(.intersection, dplyr::all_of(percent_cols)) %>%
    tidyr::pivot_longer(
      cols      = dplyr::all_of(percent_cols),
      names_to  = "group",
      values_to = "percent"
    )
  
  ## pretty names
  if (!is.null(group_name_map)) {
    stopifnot(all(names(group_name_map) %in% unique(long_df$group)))
    long_df$group <- dplyr::recode(long_df$group, !!!group_name_map)
  }
  
  ## stacking / legend order
  if (!is.null(group_order)) {
    stopifnot(setequal(group_order, unique(long_df$group)))
    long_df$group <- factor(long_df$group, levels = group_order)
  } else {
    long_df$group <- factor(long_df$group)
  }
  
  ## x‑axis order
  if (is.null(x_order)) {
    x_order <- long_df %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(set_count = stringr::str_count(.intersection, "∩") + 1) %>% 
      dplyr::distinct(.intersection, set_count) %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(set_count), .intersection) %>% 
      dplyr::pull(.intersection)
  }
  long_df$.intersection <- factor(long_df$.intersection, levels = x_order)
  
  ## list_of_overlaps
  if (is.null(list_of_overlaps)) {
    list_of_overlaps <- lapply(split(df[cell_cols], df$.intersection), function(sub){
      cell_cols[as.logical(sub[1, ])]
    })
  }
  list_of_overlaps <- list_of_overlaps[x_order]
  
  ## y‑axis breaks — always include 100 and append '%'
  max_y <- max(
    long_df$percent,
    100,
    if (!is.null(y_line) && is.numeric(y_line) && is.finite(y_line)) y_line else -Inf,
    na.rm = TRUE
  )
  base_breaks <- seq(0, ceiling(max_y / 10) * 10, by = 10)
  if (!is.null(y_line) && is.numeric(y_line) && is.finite(y_line)) {
    y_breaks <- sort(unique(c(base_breaks, y_line)))
  } else {
    y_breaks <- base_breaks
  }
  
  ## ── stacked bar plot (style aligned with get_overlap_* function) ──────────
  p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(long_df, ggplot2::aes(x = .intersection, y = percent, fill = group)) +
    ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.8) +
    ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(breaks = y_breaks, labels = function(b) paste0(b, "%")) +
    ggplot2::labs(
      title = plot_title,
      x     = x_title,
      y     = y_title,
      fill  = legend_title
    ) +
    ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
    ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
    ggplot2::theme(
      plot.title.position = "panel",  # center relative to the barplot panel, not whole plot
      plot.title          = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold",
                                                  size = title_size,
                                                  margin = ggplot2::margin(t = 10, b = 4)),
      axis.title.x        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
      axis.title.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
      axis.text.y         = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size),
      axis.text.x         = ggplot2::element_blank(),   # hidden; matrix goes underneath
      axis.ticks.x        = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      legend.title        = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
      legend.text         = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
      panel.grid.major.x  = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      panel.grid.minor    = ggplot2::element_blank(),
      plot.margin         = ggplot2::margin(t = 6, r = 5, b = 4, l = 5)
    )
  
  ## dashed reference line only if requested
  if (!is.null(y_line) && is.numeric(y_line) && length(y_line) == 1 && is.finite(y_line)) {
    p_bar <- p_bar + ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = y_line, linetype = "dashed")
  }
  
  ## palette + flipped legend order (stacking order unchanged)
  if (!is.null(group_palette)) {
    stopifnot(all(unique(long_df$group) %in% names(group_palette)))
    p_bar <- p_bar + ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
      values = group_palette,
      breaks = rev(levels(long_df$group))
    )
  } else {
    p_bar <- p_bar + ggplot2::guides(fill = ggplot2::guide_legend(reverse = TRUE))
  }
  
  ## ── intersection matrix ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  matrix_plot <- get_intersection_matrix(
    ord               = x_order,
    list_of_overlaps  = list_of_overlaps,
    cell_order_mat    = cell_order_mat,
    base_size         = base_size,
    mat_row_text_size = mat_row_text_size
  )
  
  ## ── combine ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!requireNamespace("cowplot", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package 'cowplot' is required for assembling the plots.", call. = FALSE)
  
  combined_plot <- cowplot::plot_grid(
    p_bar,
    matrix_plot,
    ncol        = 1,
    align       = "v",
    rel_heights = heights
  )
  
  ## ── return ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  list(
    plot      = combined_plot,
    bar_plot  = p_bar,
    mat_plot  = matrix_plot,
    data_long = long_df
  )
}
```

```{r, "Old create_meta_table function", eval=FALSE}
create_meta_table <- function(output_list) {
  # 1) Flatten output_list into a simple list of "sample" objects.
  #    Each "sample" has sample$original_table.
  #    unlist(..., recursive = FALSE) unwraps one level so we can iterate over them directly.
  samples_list <- unlist(output_list, recursive = FALSE)
  
  # 2) Combine all sample$original_table data into one big data frame:
  #    - Convert each sample's table into a data frame
  #    - Add a "gene" column from the rownames
  
  samples_names <- names(samples_list)             # keep the names once
  combined_df <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_along(samples_list), function(i) {
    df <- samples_list[[i]]$original_table
    df$gene    <- rownames(df)
    df$dataset <- sub("\\..*$", "", samples_names[i])   # e.g. "Mevorach.CD55-control" → "Mevorach"
    df
  }))
  
  # 3) Precompute columns to support dsi_scores:
  #    - "is_up" = 1 if avg_log2FC >= 1 & p_val_adj <= 0.05, else 0
  #    - "is_down" = 1 if avg_log2FC <= -1 & p_val_adj <= 0.05, else 0
  #    These let us sum up upregulated/downregulated counts by gene.
  combined_df <- combined_df %>%
    mutate(
      is_up = ifelse(!is.na(avg_log2FC) & avg_log2FC >= 1 &
                       !is.na(p_val_adj)  & p_val_adj <= 0.05, 1, 0),
      is_down = ifelse(!is.na(avg_log2FC) & avg_log2FC <= -1 &
                         !is.na(p_val_adj) & p_val_adj <= 0.05, 1, 0)
    )
  
  # 4) Summarize per gene using dplyr:
  #    This replaces the nested for-loops. We group by gene, then
  #    aggregate stats: comparisons_num, fisher_score, valid_comparisons, etc.
  
  meta_table <- combined_df %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarize(
      comparisons_num    = n(),
      fisher_score       = sum(-2 * log(p_val), na.rm = TRUE), # sum of -2*ln(p_val)
      valid_comparisons  = sum(!is.na(p_val)), # how many p_vals are not NA
      ## exclude Mevorach rows whose p_val > 0.05
      avg_log2FC   = mean( avg_log2FC[ !(dataset == "Mevorach" & p_val > 0.05) ], na.rm = TRUE ),
      median_log2FC= median( avg_log2FC[ !(dataset == "Mevorach" & p_val > 0.05) ], na.rm = TRUE ),
      num_upregulated    = sum(is_up),
      num_downregulated  = sum(is_down),
      dsi                = sum(is_up) - sum(is_down) # dsi = (#up) - (#down)
    ) %>%
    ungroup()
  
  
  # 5) Compute Fisher’s combined p-values, then BH adjust:
  #    - If valid_comparisons == 0, set NA
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    mutate(
      p_val_fisher = if_else(
        valid_comparisons == 0,
        NA_real_,
        1 - pchisq(fisher_score, df = 2 * valid_comparisons)
      ),
      q_val_fisher = p.adjust(p_val_fisher, method = "BH")
    )
  
  # 6) Round numeric columns where needed, to match your original
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    mutate(
      fisher         = round(fisher_score, 2),
      avg_log2FC     = round(avg_log2FC, 2)
      # median_log2FC can remain unrounded or you can also round it if you want:
      # median_log2FC = round(median_log2FC, 2)
    )
  
  # 7) Reorder columns to match your original output format
  #    and keep the data frame structure consistent.
  meta_table <- meta_table %>%
    dplyr::select(
      gene,
      # "comparisons_num", "dsi", "num_upregulated", "num_downregulated",
      # "avg_log2FC", "median_log2FC", "fisher", "valid_comparisons",
      # "p_val_fisher", "q_val_fisher"
      comparisons_num,
      dsi,
      num_upregulated,
      num_downregulated,
      avg_log2FC,
      median_log2FC,
      fisher,           # from fisher_score
      valid_comparisons,
      p_val_fisher,
      q_val_fisher
    )
  meta_table <- as.data.frame(meta_table)
  
  
  # 8) Make gene names row names (optional).
  #    Remove the gene column if you like or keep it if you prefer.
  #    In your original code, "gene" wasn't an explicit column, so let's mimic that:
  rownames(meta_table) <- meta_table$gene
  
  # Return the final meta_table
  return(meta_table)
}
```

```{r, "Original get_signature_score_boxplot function", eval=FALSE}

#───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
#  get_signature_score_boxplot()
#  --------------------------------
#  Traverse a 4‑level output_lists object (cell_type → dataset → sample →
#  original_table) and compute the UCell‑style oxidative‑stress score for every
#  sample using get_output_signature_score().  Returns a tidy data.frame ready
#  for ggplot2::geom_boxplot().
#───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
get_signature_score_boxplot <- function(output_lists,
                                        positive_genes,
                                        negative_genes = NULL,
                                        pct.threshold  = 0.1,
                                        w_neg          = 1,
                                        max_rank       = 1500,
                                        filter_nocoding = TRUE) {
  ## 0 ·──────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.list(output_lists))
    stop("`output_lists` must be a named list (cell_type → dataset → sample).")
  if (missing(positive_genes) || length(positive_genes) == 0)
    stop("`positive_genes` must be a non‑empty character vector.")
  
  ## 1 ·──────── iterate and collect scores ───────────────────────────────────
  out <- lapply(names(output_lists), function(ct) {           # cell_type loop
    ct_list <- output_lists[[ct]]
    lapply(names(ct_list), function(ds) {                     # dataset loop
      ds_list <- ct_list[[ds]]
      lapply(names(ds_list), function(sm) {                   # sample loop
        obj <- ds_list[[sm]]
        if (!is.list(obj) || !"original_table" %in% names(obj)) {
          warning("Skipped ", ct, "/", ds, "/", sm, ": no 'original_table'.")
          return(NULL)
        }
        score <- get_output_signature_score(
          output_df       = obj$original_table,
          positive_genes  = positive_genes,
          negative_genes  = negative_genes,
          pct.threshold   = pct.threshold,
          w_neg           = w_neg,
          max_rank        = max_rank,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        )
        data.frame(cell_type = ct,
                   dataset   = ds,
                   sample    = sm,
                   oxidative_stress_score = score,
                   stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
      })  %>%  do.call(what = rbind)
    })  %>%  do.call(what = rbind)
  })  %>%  do.call(what = rbind)
  
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
}
```

```{r, "Finding Oxidative stress genes", eval=FALSE}
    # Helper to build inclusive intersections for one tibble
    make_inclusive_sets <- function(df, cell_cols, label_sep = " ∩ ") {
      stopifnot(all(cell_cols %in% names(df)))
      stopifnot("group_reactome" %in% names(df))
      
      # keep only non-"Other/No Pathway"
      # df <- df %>% filter(group_reactome != "Other/No Pathway")
      
      name_for <- function(req) paste(req, collapse = label_sep)
      get_subset <- function(required_cols) {
        df %>%
          filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), identity)) %>%  # inclusive: required TRUE, others can be anything
          arrange(gene)
      }
      
      out <- list()
      
      # 5-cell intersection (all five TRUE)
      out[[name_for(cell_cols)]] <- get_subset(cell_cols)
      
      # 5 "leave-one-out" 4-cell intersections (the four listed TRUE; the 5th can be TRUE/FALSE)
      for (excluded in cell_cols) {
        req <- setdiff(cell_cols, excluded)
        out[[name_for(req)]] <- get_subset(req)
      }
      
      out
    }

      "GOBP_HYDROGEN_PEROXIDE_CATABOLIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_PENTOSE_METABOLIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES",
      "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_RESPONSE_TO_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES",
      "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES",
      "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_BIOSYNTHETIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_METABOLIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_NEGATIVE_REGULATION_OF_RESPONSE_TO_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES",
      "GOMF_SUPEROXIDE_GENERATING_NAD_P_H_OXIDASE_ACTIVITY",
      "HALLMARK_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES_PATHWAY",
      "HALLMARK_OXIDATIVE_PHOSPHORYLATION",
      "REACTOME_DETOXIFICATION_OF_REACTIVE_OXYGEN_SPECIES",
      "REACTOME_OXIDATIVE_STRESS_INDUCED_SENESCENCE",
      "WEIGEL_OXIDATIVE_STRESS_BY_TBH_AND_H2O2",
      "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS",
      "GOBP_CELL_DEATH_IN_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS",
      "REACTOME_KEAP1_NFE2L2_PATHWAY",
      "BIOCARTA_ARENRF2_PATHWAY",
      "IBRAHIM_NRF2_UP",
      "IBRAHIM_NRF2_DN",
      "NRF2_01",
      "NRF2_Q4",
      "NFE2L2.V2",
      "CHUANG_OXIDATIVE_STRESS_RESPONSE_UP",
      "CHUANG_OXIDATIVE_STRESS_RESPONSE_DN",
      "GOBP_REGULATION_OF_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_OXIDATIVE_STRESS",
      "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_HYDROGEN_PEROXIDE",
      "GOBP_HYDROGEN_PEROXIDE_BIOSYNTHETIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_GLUTATHIONE_METABOLIC_PROCESS",
      "GOBP_GLUTATHIONE_TRANSPORT",
      "BIOCARTA_SODD_PATHWAY",
      "SOD1_TARGET_GENES",
      "GOBP_CELLULAR_RESPONSE_TO_NITROSATIVE_STRESS",
      "GOBP_CELL_REDOX_HOMEOSTASIS",
      "GOBP_RESPONSE_TO_REDOX_STATE",
      "GOMF_THIOREDOXIN_DISULFIDE_REDUCTASE_NADPH_ACTIVITY"
    )
    
    # fetch all MSigDB (human) gene–set memberships
    msig <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens") %>%
      filter(gs_name %in% pathways) %>%
      distinct(gs_name, gene_symbol)
    
    # split into a named list of HGNC vectors
    os_pathway_list <- split(msig$gene_symbol, msig$gs_name)
    os_pathway_list <- lapply(os_pathway_list, unique)
    
    # ensure all requested names exist (empty vector for any missing)
    missing_sets <- setdiff(pathways, names(os_pathway_list))
    if (length(missing_sets) > 0) {
      message("Not found in this MSigDB version: ", paste(missing_sets, collapse = ", "))
      for (nm in missing_sets) os_pathway_list[[nm]] <- character(0)
    }
    
    # reorder to match the input vector
    os_pathway_list <- os_pathway_list[pathways]
    
    # optional: a small metadata table you can keep alongside
    # msig_info <- msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens") %>%
    #   filter(gs_name %in% pathways) %>%
    #   distinct(gs_name, gs_collection, gs_subcollection, gs_description, gs_exact_source, gs_url)
    
  }
  
  #adding the pathways as columns 
  {
    # read your existing data
    # positive_gene_upset_df <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/multi_cell_analysis/upset/positive_gene_upset_df.qs")
    # negative_gene_upset_df <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/multi_cell_analysis/upset/negative_gene_upset_df.qs")
    # 
    
    # helper: add "group_<pathway>" columns labeling membership
    add_os_columns <- function(df, os_list) {
      stopifnot("gene" %in% names(df))
      cols <- lapply(os_list, function(genes) {
        ifelse(df$gene %in% genes, "Oxidative Stress", "Other/No Pathway")
      })
      names(cols) <- paste0("group_", names(os_list))
      bind_cols(df, as_tibble(cols))
    }
    
    # helper: drop any group_ column with zero "Oxidative Stress" entries
    remove_empty_os_cols <- function(df) {
      group_cols <- grep("^group_", names(df), value = TRUE)
      keep_cols <- group_cols[
        vapply(df[group_cols], function(x) any(x == "Oxidative Stress"), logical(1))
      ]
      df %>% dplyr::select(-setdiff(group_cols, keep_cols))
    }
    
    # update your existing tibbles in place
    positive_gene_upset_df <- positive_gene_upset_df %>%
      add_os_columns(os_pathway_list) %>%
      remove_empty_os_cols()
    
    negative_gene_upset_df <- negative_gene_upset_df %>%
      add_os_columns(os_pathway_list) %>%
      remove_empty_os_cols()
    

    
  }
  
  
  #getting intersection_composition_dfs
  {
  
    # identify the pathway‐related group_ columns, excluding the reactome/go ones
    pathway_cols_pos <- setdiff(
      grep("^group_", names(positive_gene_upset_df), value = TRUE),
      c("group_reactome", "group_reactome_copy", "group_go")
    )
    
    # build the list of intersection‐composition data.frames for positive genes
    positive_intersection_composition_list <- setNames(
      lapply(pathway_cols_pos, function(group_col) {
        get_intersection_composition_df(
          df        = positive_gene_upset_df,
          group_col = group_col,
          groups_map = c(
            "Oxidative Stress"      = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
            "Other/No Pathway"      = "Other_percent"
          )
        )
      }),
      pathway_cols_pos
    )
    
    # same for negative genes
    pathway_cols_neg <- setdiff(
      grep("^group_", names(negative_gene_upset_df), value = TRUE),
      c("group_reactome", "group_reactome_copy", "group_go")
    )
    
    negative_intersection_composition_list <- setNames(
      lapply(pathway_cols_neg, function(group_col) {
        get_intersection_composition_df(
          df        = negative_gene_upset_df,
          group_col = group_col,
          groups_map = c(
            "Oxidative Stress"      = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
            "Other/No Pathway"      = "Other_percent"
          )
        )
      }),
      pathway_cols_neg
    )
    
    
    
  }
  
  
  #getting intersection_diff_composition_lists
  {
    
    
    # 1. define the six intersection patterns
    composition_patterns <- list(
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells" = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"     = c("Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"           = c("NKs","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"         = c("NKs","Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells")
    )
    
    # 2. helper that, given a composition_list (named by pathway),
    #    returns a list (named by pattern) of data.frames with
    #    pathway_name, target_percent, avg_singlar_percent, diff
    build_diff_list <- function(composition_list) {
      all_cells <- c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells")
      
      setNames(
        lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
          cells_in  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
          cells_out <- setdiff(all_cells, cells_in)
          
          # for each pathway, compute one row of stats
          stats <- lapply(names(composition_list), function(pw) {
            df <- composition_list[[pw]]
            
            # average singleton % (intersection_num == 1)
            avg_single <- df %>%
              dplyr::filter(intersection_num == 1) %>%
              dplyr::pull(Oxidative_stress_percent) %>%
              mean(na.rm = TRUE)
            
            # target % for this exact intersection
            target_pct <- df %>%
              dplyr::filter(
                dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_in),  ~ .x) &
                  dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_out), ~ !.x)
              ) %>%
              dplyr::pull(Oxidative_stress_percent)
            
            tibble::tibble(
              pathway_name        = pw,
              target_percent      = target_pct,
              avg_singlar_percent = avg_single,
              diff                = target_pct - avg_single
            )
          })
          
          # bind all pathways into one df for this pattern
          dplyr::bind_rows(stats)
        }),
        nm = names(composition_patterns)
      )
    }
    
    # 3. build your two diff‐composition lists
    positive_intersection_diff_composition_list <- 
      build_diff_list(positive_intersection_composition_list)
    
    negative_intersection_diff_composition_list <- 
      build_diff_list(negative_intersection_composition_list)
    
  }
  
  #set diff in all the OS genes merged
  {
    # 1. Merge all OS‐pathway genes into one, deduplicated vector
    merged_os_genes <- unique(unlist(os_pathway_list))
    
    # 2. Add a single “merged” group column to each upset‐df
    positive_gene_upset_df$group_merged_OS <- ifelse(
      positive_gene_upset_df$gene %in% merged_os_genes,
      "Oxidative Stress", 
      "Other/No Pathway"
    )
    negative_gene_upset_df$group_merged_OS <- ifelse(
      negative_gene_upset_df$gene %in% merged_os_genes,
      "Oxidative Stress", 
      "Other/No Pathway"
    )
    
    # 3. Compute the intersection‐composition data.frame for this merged group
    positive_merged_intersection <- get_intersection_composition_df(
      df         = positive_gene_upset_df,
      group_col  = "group_merged_OS",
      groups_map = c(
        "Oxidative Stress"     = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
        "Other/No Pathway"     = "Other_percent"
      )
    )
    negative_merged_intersection <- get_intersection_composition_df(
      df         = negative_gene_upset_df,
      group_col  = "group_merged_OS",
      groups_map = c(
        "Oxidative Stress"     = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
        "Other/No Pathway"     = "Other_percent"
      )
    )
    
    # 4. Wrap that single df into a one‐element list, then apply your build_diff_list()
    positive_merged_diff_composition <- build_diff_list(
      list(Merged_OS = positive_merged_intersection)
    )
    negative_merged_diff_composition <- build_diff_list(
      list(Merged_OS = negative_merged_intersection)
    )
  }
  
  #get positive_OS_genes and negative_OS_genes
  {
    
    # 1. re-use your intersection patterns
    composition_patterns <- list(
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells" = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"     = c("Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"           = c("NKs","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"         = c("NKs","Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
      "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells")
    )
    
    # 2. map cell names to your meta_table_list names
    cell_meta_map <- c(
      "NKs"           = "NK_meta_table",
      "Monocytes"     = "monocytes_meta_table",
      "B Cells"       = "B_cells_meta_table",
      "CD4+ T Cells"  = "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
      "CD8+ T Cells"  = "CD8_T_cells_meta_table"
    )
    
    # 3. helper to build one OS‐gene table for a given intersection
    make_os_table <- function(gene_vec, cells) {
      rows <- lapply(gene_vec, function(g) {
        # FIXED: one TRUE/FALSE per pathway
        hits <- names(os_pathway_list)[ 
          vapply(os_pathway_list, function(path_genes) g %in% path_genes, logical(1)) 
        ]
        if (length(hits) == 0) return(NULL)
        
        # rest is unchanged...
        vals <- sapply(cell_meta_map[cells], function(meta_nm) {
          mt <- meta_table_list[[meta_nm]]
          v  <- mt$median_log2FC[mt$gene == g]
          if (length(v)==0) NA_real_ else v
        })
        
        tibble(
          gene               = g,
          count              = length(hits),
          pathways           = paste(hits, collapse = ", "),
          mean_median_log2fc = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
        )
      })
      
      bind_rows(rows)
    }
    
    get_pattern_genes <- function(df, cells_in) {
      df %>%
        dplyr::filter(
          # require presence in all cells_in
          dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_in), identity)
          # (we do not exclude presence in the other cells—this is inclusive)
        ) %>%
        dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
        unique()
    }
    
    
    # 4. build positive_OS_genes
    positive_OS_genes <- setNames(
      lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
        cells  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
        genes  <- get_pattern_genes(positive_gene_upset_df, cells)
        make_os_table(genes, cells)
      }),
      names(composition_patterns)
    )
    
    negative_OS_genes <- setNames(
      lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
        cells  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
        genes  <- get_pattern_genes(negative_gene_upset_df, cells)
        make_os_table(genes, cells)
      }),
      names(composition_patterns)
    )
    
    sapply(positive_OS_genes, nrow)
    sapply(negative_OS_genes, nrow)
  }
  

  # Observing positive genes expression in each cell type - on the ceullar level
  {
    os_signature <- c("GPX1", "GLRX5", "BOLA1", "NDUFB8", "ALDH7A1", "OGG1",
                      "NDUFC2", "MPV17L",  "DUOX1", "PARL", "EGLN2")

    os_signature_stats_df <- data.frame(
      gene = os_signature,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )

    # Loop over each cell‐type meta_table
    for(tbl_name in names(meta_tables_list)) {
      tbl <- meta_tables_list[[tbl_name]]
      idx       <- match(os_signature, rownames(tbl))
      median_fc <- tbl$median_log2FC[idx]
      pct1      <- tbl$pct.1[idx]
      score     <- median_fc * pct1 * 100

      cell_type <- sub("^meta_table_", "", tbl_name)
      col_name  <- paste0(cell_type, "_score")

      os_signature_stats_df[[col_name]] <- score
    }

    # Compute the average score across all five cell types
    score_cols <- grep("_score$", names(os_signature_stats_df), value = TRUE)
    os_signature_stats_df$avg_score <- rowMeans(os_signature_stats_df[score_cols], na.rm = TRUE)

    # For each gene, check which cell‐type score exceeds the mean of the other four by >10
    os_signature_stats_df$cell_type_DE <- apply(os_signature_stats_df[score_cols], 1, function(x) {
      other_means <- (sum(x) - x) / (length(x) - 1)
      de_types    <- names(x)[which((x - other_means) > 10)]
      if (length(de_types) == 0)
        NA_character_
      else
        paste(de_types, collapse = ",")
    })
  }

  # Observing positive genes ranks in each pairwise comparisons

  {
    
        nk_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    monocytes_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    b_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    cd4_t_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    cd8_t_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
    
    output_lists <- list(
      NKs = nk_outputlist,
      Monocytes = monocytes_outputlist,
      "B cells" = b_cells_outputlist,
      "CD4+ T cells" = cd4_t_cells_outputlist,
      "CD8+ T cells" = cd8_t_cells_outputlist)
    
    rm(nk_outputlist, monocytes_outputlist, b_cells_outputlist,
       cd4_t_cells_outputlist, cd8_t_cells_outputlist)
  
      get_gene_tables <- function(output_lists,
                                genes,
                                filter_nocoding = TRUE) {
      # Prepare the result list, one entry per cell type
      out_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(output_lists)),
                           names(output_lists))
      
      for (ct in names(output_lists)) {
        # Navigate to Mevorach → CD59-control → original_table
        obj <- output_lists[[ct]][["Mevorach"]]
        if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj[["CD59-control"]]) ||
            is.null(obj[["CD59-control"]][["original_table"]])) {
          warning("Skipping ", ct, ": no Mevorach$`CD59-control`$original_table")
          next
        }
        tbl <- obj[["CD59-control"]][["original_table"]]
        
        # 1) Filter to protein‑coding if requested
        if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
          coding_syms <- tryCatch({
            if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
              stop("Please install biomaRt")
            mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
            annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
              attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
              filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
              values     = unique(rownames(tbl)),
              mart       = mart
            )
            unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
          }, error = function(e) {
            warning("Protein‑coding filter skipped for ", ct, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
            NULL
          })
          if (!is.null(coding_syms)) {
            tbl <- tbl[rownames(tbl) %in% coding_syms, , drop = FALSE]
          }
        }
        
        # 2) Compute descending‐logFC rank
        ranks <- rank(-tbl$avg_log2FC, ties.method = "average")
        
        # 3) Build full_gene_df for all (protein‑coding) genes
        full_gene_df <- data.frame(
          gene       = rownames(tbl),
          avg_log2FC = tbl$avg_log2FC,
          pct.1      = tbl$pct.1,
          pct.2      = tbl$pct.2,
          rank       = ranks,
          stringsAsFactors = FALSE
        )
        
        # 4) Build signature_df for only the requested genes, in the same order
        #    Missing genes will become rows of NAs
        sig_idx <- match(genes, full_gene_df$gene)
        signature_df <- full_gene_df[sig_idx, , drop = FALSE]
        signature_df$gene <- genes
        
        # 5) Store both tables in the output list
        out_list[[ct]] <- list(
          signature_df  = signature_df,
          full_gene_df  = full_gene_df
        )
      }
      
      return(out_list)
    }
    
    
    my_genes <- c("GPX1", "GLRX5", "BOLA1", "NDUFB8", "ALDH7A1", "OGG1",
                  "NDUFC2", "MPV17L",  "DUOX1", "PARL", "EGLN2",
                  
                  "NCF1", "CDKN1A", "SQSTM1", "AREG", "DHRS4", "THBS1", "TNF",
                  "BCKDHA", "NDUFV2", "SOD2", "TNFAIP3", "DDIT3", "HIF1A", "HMOX1",
                  "BCL2")
    
    gene_tables <- get_gene_tables(output_lists, my_genes)
    
}
```

```{r, "old get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample function", eval=FALSE}


get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample <- function(
    seu,
    filter_nocoding   = TRUE,
    assay             = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector       = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector   = NULL
) {
  ## ──────────────────────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────
  if (!"final_cell_type" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))
    stop("Column `final_cell_type` not found in `seu@meta.data`.")
  
  if (is.null(KEGG_vector) && is.null(REACTOME_vector))
    stop("Nothing to compute: both `KEGG_vector` and `REACTOME_vector` are NULL.")
  
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!requireNamespace("scMetabolism", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package ‘scMetabolism’ (provides sc.metabolism.Seurat) is not installed.")
  
  ## ── 1. grab the SCT ‘corrected counts’ matrix ───────────────────────────
  sct_counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
  
  ## ── 1a. OPTIONAL: keep only protein-coding genes ────────────────────────
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = rownames(sct_counts),
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ",
              conditionMessage(e), ").")
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(coding_syms)) {
      keep <- intersect(rownames(sct_counts), coding_syms)
      sct_counts <- sct_counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 2. create a legacy RNA assay & set as default ───────────────────────
  seu[["RNA"]]  <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sct_counts)
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
  
  ## ── shared objects for later ────────────────────────────────────────────
  cell_type_vec <- setNames(
    as.character(seu@meta.data$final_cell_type),
    rownames(seu@meta.data)
  )
  cell_types <- sort(setdiff(unique(cell_type_vec), "Other"))  # desired columns
  
  ## helper: median per cell-type for a vector of pathways ──────────────────
  median_one_set <- function(seu_obj, pathways) {
    mat         <- seu_obj@assays$METABOLISM$score
    cell_names  <- colnames(mat)
    
    lapply(pathways, function(pw) {
      idx <- grep(paste0("^", pw, "$"), rownames(mat), ignore.case = TRUE)
      
      vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(cell_types)), cell_types)  # default NA
      if (length(idx) == 1) {
        auc <- as.numeric(mat[idx, ])
        names(auc) <- sub("^([^.]+)\\.(.*)\\.(\\d+)$", "\\1-\\2-\\3", cell_names)
        
        common <- intersect(names(auc), names(cell_type_vec))
        if (length(common) > 0) {
          med <- tapply(auc[common], cell_type_vec[common], median, na.rm = TRUE)
          vec[names(med)] <- med
        }
      }
      return(vec)
    }) |>
      setNames(pathways)
  }
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  ## ── 3. KEGG block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector) && length(KEGG_vector) > 0) {
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "KEGG"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, KEGG_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 4. REACTOME block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector) && length(REACTOME_vector) > 0) {
    seu@assays$METABOLISM$score <- NULL  # drop prior KEGG scores
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "REACTOME"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, REACTOME_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 5. bind into tidy data-frame ────────────────────────────────────────
  path_mat <- do.call(rbind, results_list)               # rbind aligns by names
  med_df   <- as.data.frame(path_mat)
  med_df$pathway <- rownames(med_df)
  med_df <- med_df[, c("pathway", cell_types)]            # order columns
  rownames(med_df) <- NULL
  
  return(med_df)
}
```

```{r, "old get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset function", eval=FALSE}
 ## ---- wrapper ------------------------------------------------------------
 get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset <- function(
    seu_obj,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL
 ) {
   # 1. outer list keyed by orig.ident (“Hong”, “Kang”, …)
   orig_ids <- unique(seu_obj$orig.ident)
   res_out  <- setNames(vector("list", length(orig_ids)), orig_ids)
   
   for (oid in orig_ids) {
     seu_oid   <- subset(seu_obj, subset = orig.ident == oid)
     samp_ids  <- sort(unique(seu_oid$sample))   # HC-1 … HC-n
     
     # 2. inner list keyed by sample
     samp_list <- lapply(samp_ids, function(samp) {
       seu_samp <- subset(seu_oid, subset = sample == samp)
       
       get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
         seu             = seu_samp,
         filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
         assay           = assay,
         KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
         REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
       )
     })
     names(samp_list) <- samp_ids
     res_out[[oid]]   <- samp_list
   }
   
   return(res_out)
 }
```

```{r, "Patietn cell level oxidative streess signature score", eval=FALSE}
{
  
  
  get_cd59_signature <- function(positive_top_genes,
                                 negative_top_genes = NULL,
                                 seu,
                                 signature_name = "cd59_signature") {
    # 1) build the gene vector (append "-" to negative genes if provided)
    gene_sig <- positive_top_genes
    if (!is.null(negative_top_genes)) {
      neg_marked <- paste0(negative_top_genes, "-")
      gene_sig   <- c(gene_sig, neg_marked)
    }
    
    # 2) wrap it in a named list, using the user-supplied signature_name
    signatures <- setNames(list(gene_sig), signature_name)
    
    # 3) add the UCell module score
    seu <- AddModuleScore_UCell(seu,
                                features = signatures,
                                name     = NULL)
    
    return(seu)
  }
  
  
  
  seu_cd59 <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/seu_cd59_only_patient_full_annotation.qs") #, "BOLA1", "OGG1", "ALDH7A1"
  counts <- GetAssayData(my_seurat_obj, assay = "SCT", layer = "counts")
  # 1. Query BioMart for protein‑coding symbols among your gene set
  coding_syms <- tryCatch({
    if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
      stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
    mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
    annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
      attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
      filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
      values     = unique(rownames(counts)),
      mart       = mart
    )
    unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
  }, error = function(e) {
    warning("Protein‑coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ", conditionMessage(e), ").")
    NULL
  })
  
  # 2. Identify non‑protein‑coding gene row‑indices
  if (is.null(coding_syms)) {
    noncoding_idx <- integer(0)
  } else {
    noncoding_idx <- which(!rownames(counts) %in% coding_syms)
  }
  
  try <- counts[-noncoding_idx,]
  
  seu_cd59 <- subset(seu_cd59, features = rownames(try))
```

```{r, "Finding TNFA_NFKB genes", eval=FALSE}
  )
  
  ## ---- 2.  “Negative” genes  --------------------------------------------------

  )
  
  ## (Optional) make sure the new lists carry the same element names

  negative_gene_upset_df <- add_pathway_group_reactome_and_goslim (negative_gene_upset_df,  BPPARAM = param)

  cell_cols <- c("NKs", "Monocytes", "B Cells", "CD4+ T Cells", "CD8+ T Cells")
  
  # Helper to build inclusive intersections for one tibble
  make_inclusive_sets <- function(df, cell_cols, label_sep = " ∩ ") {
    stopifnot(all(cell_cols %in% names(df)))
    stopifnot("group_reactome" %in% names(df))
    
    # keep only non-"Other/No Pathway"
    # df <- df %>% filter(group_reactome != "Other/No Pathway")
    
    name_for <- function(req) paste(req, collapse = label_sep)
    get_subset <- function(required_cols) {
      df %>%
        filter(if_all(all_of(required_cols), identity)) %>%  # inclusive: required TRUE, others can be anything
        arrange(gene)
    }
    
    out <- list()
    
    # 5-cell intersection (all five TRUE)
    out[[name_for(cell_cols)]] <- get_subset(cell_cols)
    
    # 5 "leave-one-out" 4-cell intersections (the four listed TRUE; the 5th can be TRUE/FALSE)
    for (excluded in cell_cols) {
      req <- setdiff(cell_cols, excluded)
      out[[name_for(req)]] <- get_subset(req)
    }
    
    out
  }
  
  special_genes_list <- list(
    positive_genes = make_inclusive_sets(positive_gene_upset_df, cell_cols),
    negative_genes = make_inclusive_sets(negative_gene_upset_df, cell_cols)
  )
  
  # Example: names of the created data frames
  names(special_genes_list$positive_genes)
  names(special_genes_list$negative_genes)
  
  
  
}

      ifelse(df$gene %in% genes, "Oxidative Stress", "Other/No Pathway")

    keep_cols <- group_cols[
      vapply(df[group_cols], function(x) any(x == "Oxidative Stress"), logical(1))
    ]

#getting intersection_diff_composition_lists
{
  
  
  # 1. define the six intersection patterns
  composition_patterns <- list(
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells" = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"     = c("Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"           = c("NKs","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"         = c("NKs","Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells")
  )
  
  # 2. helper that, given a composition_list (named by pathway),
  #    returns a list (named by pattern) of data.frames with
  #    pathway_name, target_percent, avg_singlar_percent, diff
  build_diff_list <- function(composition_list) {
    all_cells <- c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells")
    
    setNames(
      lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
        cells_in  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
        cells_out <- setdiff(all_cells, cells_in)
        
        # for each pathway, compute one row of stats
        stats <- lapply(names(composition_list), function(pw) {
          df <- composition_list[[pw]]
          
          # average singleton % (intersection_num == 1)
          avg_single <- df %>%
            dplyr::filter(intersection_num == 1) %>%
            dplyr::pull(Oxidative_stress_percent) %>%
            mean(na.rm = TRUE)
          
          # target % for this exact intersection
          target_pct <- df %>%
            dplyr::filter(
              dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_in),  ~ .x) &
                dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_out), ~ !.x)
            ) %>%
            dplyr::pull(Oxidative_stress_percent)
          
          tibble::tibble(
            pathway_name        = pw,
            target_percent      = target_pct,
            avg_singlar_percent = avg_single,
            diff                = target_pct - avg_single
          )
        })
        
        # bind all pathways into one df for this pattern
        dplyr::bind_rows(stats)
      }),
      nm = names(composition_patterns)
    )
  }
  
  # 3. build your two diff‐composition lists
  positive_intersection_diff_composition_list <- 
    build_diff_list(positive_intersection_composition_list)
  
  negative_intersection_diff_composition_list <- 
    build_diff_list(negative_intersection_composition_list)
  
}

#set diff in all the OS genes merged
{
  # 1. Merge all OS‐pathway genes into one, deduplicated vector
  merged_os_genes <- unique(unlist(os_pathway_list))
  
  # 2. Add a single “merged” group column to each upset‐df
  positive_gene_upset_df$group_merged_OS <- ifelse(
    positive_gene_upset_df$gene %in% merged_os_genes,
    "Oxidative Stress", 
    "Other/No Pathway"
  )
  negative_gene_upset_df$group_merged_OS <- ifelse(
    negative_gene_upset_df$gene %in% merged_os_genes,
    "Oxidative Stress", 
    "Other/No Pathway"
  )
  
  # 3. Compute the intersection‐composition data.frame for this merged group
  positive_merged_intersection <- get_intersection_composition_df(
    df         = positive_gene_upset_df,
    group_col  = "group_merged_OS",
    groups_map = c(
      "Oxidative Stress"     = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
      "Other/No Pathway"     = "Other_percent"
    )
  )
  negative_merged_intersection <- get_intersection_composition_df(
    df         = negative_gene_upset_df,
    group_col  = "group_merged_OS",
    groups_map = c(
      "Oxidative Stress"     = "Oxidative_stress_percent",
      "Other/No Pathway"     = "Other_percent"
    )
  )
  
  # 4. Wrap that single df into a one‐element list, then apply your build_diff_list()
  positive_merged_diff_composition <- build_diff_list(
    list(Merged_OS = positive_merged_intersection)
  )
  negative_merged_diff_composition <- build_diff_list(
    list(Merged_OS = negative_merged_intersection)
  )
}

#get positive_OS_genes and negative_OS_genes
{
  
  # 1. re-use your intersection patterns
  composition_patterns <- list(
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells" = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"     = c("Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"           = c("NKs","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_CD4+_T_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"         = c("NKs","Monocytes","CD4+ T Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD8+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD8+ T Cells"),
    "NKs_Monocytes_B_Cells_CD4+_T_Cells"              = c("NKs","Monocytes","B Cells","CD4+ T Cells")
  )
  
  # 2. map cell names to your meta_table_list names
  cell_meta_map <- c(
    "NKs"           = "NK_meta_table",
    "Monocytes"     = "monocytes_meta_table",
    "B Cells"       = "B_cells_meta_table",
    "CD4+ T Cells"  = "CD4_T_cells_meta_table",
    "CD8+ T Cells"  = "CD8_T_cells_meta_table"
  )
  
  # 3. helper to build one OS‐gene table for a given intersection
  make_os_table <- function(gene_vec, cells) {
    rows <- lapply(gene_vec, function(g) {
      # FIXED: one TRUE/FALSE per pathway
      hits <- names(os_pathway_list)[ 
        vapply(os_pathway_list, function(path_genes) g %in% path_genes, logical(1)) 
      ]
      if (length(hits) == 0) return(NULL)
      
      # rest is unchanged...
      vals <- sapply(cell_meta_map[cells], function(meta_nm) {
        mt <- meta_table_list[[meta_nm]]
        v  <- mt$median_log2FC[mt$gene == g]
        if (length(v)==0) NA_real_ else v
      })
      
      tibble(
        gene               = g,
        count              = length(hits),
        pathways           = paste(hits, collapse = ", "),
        mean_median_log2fc = mean(vals, na.rm = TRUE)
      )
    })
    
    bind_rows(rows)
  }
  
  get_pattern_genes <- function(df, cells_in) {
    df %>%
      dplyr::filter(
        # require presence in all cells_in
        dplyr::if_all(dplyr::all_of(cells_in), identity)
        # (we do not exclude presence in the other cells—this is inclusive)
      ) %>%
      dplyr::pull(gene) %>%
      unique()
  }
  
  
  # 4. build positive_OS_genes
  positive_OS_genes <- setNames(
    lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
      cells  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
      genes  <- get_pattern_genes(positive_gene_upset_df, cells)
      make_os_table(genes, cells)
    }),
    names(composition_patterns)
  )
  
  negative_OS_genes <- setNames(
    lapply(names(composition_patterns), function(pat) {
      cells  <- composition_patterns[[pat]]
      genes  <- get_pattern_genes(negative_gene_upset_df, cells)
      make_os_table(genes, cells)
    }),
    names(composition_patterns)
  )
  
  sapply(positive_OS_genes, nrow)
  sapply(negative_OS_genes, nrow)
}


# Observing positive genes expression in each cell type - on the ceullar level
{
  os_signature <- c("GPX1", "GLRX5", "BOLA1", "NDUFB8", "ALDH7A1", "OGG1",
                    "NDUFC2", "MPV17L",  "DUOX1", "PARL", "EGLN2")
  
  os_signature_stats_df <- data.frame(
    gene = os_signature,
    stringsAsFactors = FALSE
  )
  
  # Loop over each cell‐type meta_table
  for(tbl_name in names(meta_tables_list)) {
    tbl <- meta_tables_list[[tbl_name]]
    idx       <- match(os_signature, rownames(tbl))
    median_fc <- tbl$median_log2FC[idx]
    pct1      <- tbl$pct.1[idx]
    score     <- median_fc * pct1 * 100
    
    cell_type <- sub("^meta_table_", "", tbl_name)
    col_name  <- paste0(cell_type, "_score")
    
    os_signature_stats_df[[col_name]] <- score
  }
  
  # Compute the average score across all five cell types
  score_cols <- grep("_score$", names(os_signature_stats_df), value = TRUE)
  os_signature_stats_df$avg_score <- rowMeans(os_signature_stats_df[score_cols], na.rm = TRUE)
  
  # For each gene, check which cell‐type score exceeds the mean of the other four by >10
  os_signature_stats_df$cell_type_DE <- apply(os_signature_stats_df[score_cols], 1, function(x) {
    other_means <- (sum(x) - x) / (length(x) - 1)
    de_types    <- names(x)[which((x - other_means) > 10)]
    if (length(de_types) == 0)
      NA_character_
    else
      paste(de_types, collapse = ",")
  })
}

# Observing positive genes ranks in each pairwise comparisons

{
  
  nk_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/NK/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
  monocytes_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/Monocytes/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
  b_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/B_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
  cd4_t_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD4_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
  cd8_t_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")
  
  output_lists <- list(
    NKs = nk_outputlist,
    Monocytes = monocytes_outputlist,
    "B cells" = b_cells_outputlist,
    "CD4+ T cells" = cd4_t_cells_outputlist,
    "CD8+ T cells" = cd8_t_cells_outputlist)
  
  rm(nk_outputlist, monocytes_outputlist, b_cells_outputlist,
     cd4_t_cells_outputlist, cd8_t_cells_outputlist)
  
  get_gene_tables <- function(output_lists,
                              genes,
                              filter_nocoding = TRUE) {
    # Prepare the result list, one entry per cell type
    out_list <- setNames(vector("list", length(output_lists)),
                         names(output_lists))
    
    for (ct in names(output_lists)) {
      # Navigate to Mevorach → CD59-control → original_table
      obj <- output_lists[[ct]][["Mevorach"]]
      if (is.null(obj) || is.null(obj[["CD59-control"]]) ||
          is.null(obj[["CD59-control"]][["original_table"]])) {
        warning("Skipping ", ct, ": no Mevorach$`CD59-control`$original_table")
        next
      }
      tbl <- obj[["CD59-control"]][["original_table"]]
      
      # 1) Filter to protein‑coding if requested
      if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
        coding_syms <- tryCatch({
          if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
            stop("Please install biomaRt")
          mart <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
          annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
            attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
            filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
            values     = unique(rownames(tbl)),
            mart       = mart
          )
          unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
        }, error = function(e) {
          warning("Protein‑coding filter skipped for ", ct, ": ", conditionMessage(e))
          NULL
        })
        if (!is.null(coding_syms)) {
          tbl <- tbl[rownames(tbl) %in% coding_syms, , drop = FALSE]
        }
      }
      
      # 2) Compute descending‐logFC rank
      ranks <- rank(-tbl$avg_log2FC, ties.method = "average")
      
      # 3) Build full_gene_df for all (protein‑coding) genes
      full_gene_df <- data.frame(
        gene       = rownames(tbl),
        avg_log2FC = tbl$avg_log2FC,
        pct.1      = tbl$pct.1,
        pct.2      = tbl$pct.2,
        rank       = ranks,
        stringsAsFactors = FALSE
      )
      
      # 4) Build signature_df for only the requested genes, in the same order
      #    Missing genes will become rows of NAs
      sig_idx <- match(genes, full_gene_df$gene)
      signature_df <- full_gene_df[sig_idx, , drop = FALSE]
      signature_df$gene <- genes
      
      # 5) Store both tables in the output list
      out_list[[ct]] <- list(
        signature_df  = signature_df,
        full_gene_df  = full_gene_df
      )
    }
    
    return(out_list)
  }
  
  
  my_genes <- c("GPX1", "GLRX5", "BOLA1", "NDUFB8", "ALDH7A1", "OGG1",
                "NDUFC2", "MPV17L",  "DUOX1", "PARL", "EGLN2",
                
                "NCF1", "CDKN1A", "SQSTM1", "AREG", "DHRS4", "THBS1", "TNF",
                "BCKDHA", "NDUFV2", "SOD2", "TNFAIP3", "DDIT3", "HIF1A", "HMOX1",
                "BCL2")
  
  gene_tables <- get_gene_tables(output_lists, my_genes)
  
}
```

```{r, "old get_scMetab_log2fc_barplot function", eval=FALSE}


get_scMetab_log2fc_barplot <- function(
    controls_medians = NULL,
    seu_patient,
    healthy_list,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL,
    title              = "Ox-stress pathways (patient vs. controls)",
    my_pathway_cols    = c("Glutathione metabolism" = "#fb8500",
                           "Oxidative phosphorylation" = "#219ebc"),
    title_size        = 12,
    y_title_size      = 12,
    y_text_size       = 12,
    mat_row_text_size = 12,
    legend_title_size = 12,
    legend_text_size  = 12,
    base_size         = 12) {
  ## ── 0 · sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    if (!is.list(healthy_list) || length(healthy_list) == 0)
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a non-empty *list* of Seurat objects.")
    
    if (is.null(names(healthy_list)) || any(names(healthy_list) == ""))
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a *named* list (e.g. names like 'seu_cd55').")
    
    if (anyDuplicated(names(healthy_list)))
      stop("`healthy_list` contains duplicated names: ",
           paste(unique(names(healthy_list)[duplicated(names(healthy_list))]),
                 collapse = ", "))
    
    not_seurat <- !vapply(healthy_list, inherits, logical(1), what = "Seurat")
    if (any(not_seurat))
      stop("All elements of `healthy_list` must be Seurat objects. ",
           "Problems at positions: ", paste(which(not_seurat), collapse = ", "))
  } else {
    if (!is.list(controls_medians) || length(controls_medians) == 0)
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a non-empty list produced by ",
           "`get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset()`.")
    if (is.null(names(controls_medians)) || any(names(controls_medians) == ""))
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a *named* list.")
    
    bad <- vapply(controls_medians, function(x) {
      # x should be a list of donors, each a list of sample-DFs
      if (!is.list(x) || length(x) < 1) return(TRUE)
      
      # for each donor (y), and each sample-DF (z), check the DF and its colnames
      donor_ok <- vapply(x, function(y) {
        if (!is.list(y) || length(y) < 1) return(FALSE)
        all(vapply(y, function(z) {
          is.data.frame(z) && "pathway" %in% colnames(z)
        }, logical(1)))
      }, logical(1))
      
      # bad if any donor failed
      !all(donor_ok)
    }, logical(1))
    
    if (any(bad)) {
      stop("`controls_medians` has unexpected structure at positions: ",
           paste(which(bad), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }  # <-- missing brace added here
  
  ## ── 1 · run get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample() on patient ─
  patient_medians <- get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
    seu             = seu_patient,
    filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
    assay           = assay,
    KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
    REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
  )
  
  ## ── 2 · controls (compute only if not supplied) ──────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    controls_medians <- lapply(healthy_list, function(seu_obj) {
      print(seu_obj@meta.data$orig.ident)
      get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset(
        seu_obj         = seu_obj,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        assay           = assay,
        KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
        REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
      )
    })
    names(controls_medians) <- names(healthy_list)
  }
  
  control_medians <- controls_medians
  
  ## ── 3 · flatten & merge by dataset ───────────────────────────────────────
  {
    dataset_lists  <- lapply(control_medians, function(x) x[[1]])
    dataset_names  <- sapply(control_medians, function(x) names(x)[1])
    
    merged <- list()
    for (i in seq_along(dataset_lists)) {
      ds <- dataset_names[i]
      if (!ds %in% names(merged)) {
        merged[[ds]] <- dataset_lists[[i]]
      } else {
        merged[[ds]] <- c(merged[[ds]], dataset_lists[[i]])
      }
    }
    control_medians <- merged
  }
  
  ## ── 4 · calculate controls medians ───────────────────────────────────────
  {
    sample_list <- do.call(c, control_medians)
    pathways    <- sample_list[[1]]$pathway
    cell_types  <- setdiff(names(sample_list[[1]]), "pathway")
    
    control_medians_df <- data.frame(pathway = pathways, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      mat <- sapply(sample_list, `[[`, ct)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_median")]] <- apply(mat, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_nNA")]]    <- apply(mat, 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 5 · calculate log2FC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    clean_pathway <- function(x) {
      x <- trimws(x)
      x <- gsub("([A-Za-z0-9])\\.([A-Za-z0-9])", "\\1 \\2", x)  # word.word -> word word
      x
    }
    
    patient_medians$pathway    <- clean_pathway(patient_medians$pathway)
    control_medians_df$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_medians_df$pathway)
    
    fc_df <- merge(
      patient_medians,
      control_medians_df,
      by       = "pathway",
      suffixes = c("_patient", "_control")
    )
    
    cell_types <- c("B cells", "CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells", "Monocytes", "NK cells")
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      pat_col  <- ct
      ctrl_col <- paste0(ct, "_median")
      out_col  <- paste0(ct, "_log2FC")
      
      fc_df[[out_col]] <- log2(
        (fc_df[[pat_col]]  + 1e-6) /
          (fc_df[[ctrl_col]] + 1e-6)
      )
    }
    log2fc_only <- fc_df[, c("pathway", paste0(cell_types, "_log2FC"))]
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = ends_with("_log2FC"),
        names_to  = "cell_type",
        values_to = "log2FC"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        cell_type = sub("_log2FC$", "", cell_type),
        cell_type = gsub("\\.+", " ", cell_type)
      )
  }
  
  # Calculate CIs and q value
  {
    patient_long <- patient_medians %>%
      pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "patient_median")
    
    control_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(control_medians, function(dataset_list, dataset) {
      purrr::imap_dfr(dataset_list, function(sample_df, sample_id) {
        sample_df %>%
          pivot_longer(cols = -pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "control_median") %>%
          mutate(dataset = dataset, sample_id = sample_id)
      })
    })
    
    patient_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(patient_long$pathway)
    control_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_long$pathway)
    
    merged <- patient_long %>%
      inner_join(control_long, by = c("pathway", "cell_type")) %>%
      mutate(log2fc_each = log2(patient_median / control_median))
    
    summary_df <- merged %>%
      group_by(pathway, cell_type) %>%
      summarise(
        log2FC    = mean(log2fc_each),
        se        = sd(log2fc_each) / sqrt(n()),
        t95       = qt(0.975, df = n() - 1),
        CI_top    = log2FC +  t95 * se,
        CI_bottom = log2FC -  t95 * se,
        p_val     = t.test(log2fc_each, mu = 0)$p.value,
        .groups   = "drop"
      ) %>%
      mutate(q_val = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"))
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      left_join(summary_df %>% 
                  dplyr::select(pathway, cell_type, CI_top, CI_bottom, q_val),
                by = c("pathway", "cell_type"))
  }
  
  # barplot
  {
    pdat <- log2fc_only
    pdodge <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.65)
    
    order_vec <- pdat %>%
      filter(pathway == "Glutathione metabolism") %>% 
      arrange(desc(log2FC)) %>% 
      pull(cell_type)
    
    pdat <- pdat %>% 
      mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = order_vec))
    
    pdodge <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.65)
    
    p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      pdat,
      ggplot2::aes(x = cell_type, y = log2FC, fill = pathway)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, position = pdodge) +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI_bottom, ymax = CI_top),
        width = 0.4, position = pdodge, linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        values = my_pathway_cols,
        labels = stringr::str_to_title(names(my_pathway_cols)),
        name   = "Pathway"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.5, 1),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0)
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = expression(log[2] * " EF"),
        title = title
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = title_size),
        axis.title.y       = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
        axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size),
        axis.text.x        = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = y_text_size),
        axis.ticks.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
        legend.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
        panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }
  
  list(
    control_medians = control_medians,
    log2fc_df       = log2fc_only,
    p_bar           = p_bar
  )
}
```

```{r, "Oxidative stress biological analysis", eval=FALSE}
    cd8_t_cells_outputlist <- qread("/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/data/CD8_T_cells/output_lists/neuroimmunological-healthy/CD59.Def_Mevorach_CD59_Patient_outputlist.qs")

      {

    
        wanted   <- c("NK cells","B cells","Monocytes","CD4+ T cells","CD8+ T cells")
        present  <- intersect(wanted, as.character(unique(seu_cd59$final_cell_type)))
        
        scores_df <- do.call(rbind, lapply(present, function(lbl) {

        }))
```
