```{r, "Oxidative stress biological analysis", eval=FALSE}
        high_cols <- c(
          "NK cells"      = "#B62055",
          "B cells"       = "#009E73",
          "Monocytes"     = "#56B4E9",
          "CD4+ T cells"  = "#F0E442",
          "CD8+ T cells"  = "#F37707"
        )
        
        # --- panel maker: axes end at 0.5, exactly 10 bins per axis (0.05 width)
        make_biheat <- function(df, ct, high_color) {
          panel_df <- df %>%
            dplyr::filter(cell_type == ct,
                          oxidative_stress_signature <= 0.4,
                          TNFA_NFKB_signature        <= 0.4)
          
          ggplot2::ggplot(panel_df,
                          ggplot2::aes(x = oxidative_stress_signature,
                                       y = TNFA_NFKB_signature)) +
            ggplot2::geom_bin2d(
              binwidth = c(0.05, 0.05),  # 10 bins per axis over [0, 0.5]
              ggplot2::aes(fill = ggplot2::after_stat(100 * count / sum(count)))
            ) +
            ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient(
              low = "grey92", high = high_color,
              trans = "sqrt",
              name = "% of cells",
              labels = function(x) sprintf("%.1f%%", x)
            ) +
            ggplot2::scale_x_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)) +
            ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(limits = c(0, 0.5), breaks = seq(0, 0.5, 0.1)) +
            ggplot2::coord_fixed(expand = FALSE) +
            ggplot2::labs(title = ct,
                          x = "Oxidative stress (UCell)",
                          y = "TNFα–NFκB (UCell)") +
            ggplot2::theme_bw(base_size = 14) +

              plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),

              legend.text  = ggplot2::element_text(size = 10)
            )
        }

        })

          width    = 17,
          height   = 12,
          units    = "in",
          dpi      = 200
        )

      {
        

        
        # choose quantiles
        q_os_high <- 0.75   # top quartile = "high oxidative stress"
        q_nf_low  <- 0.1   # bottom decile = "low / near-zero NF-κB"
        
        quadrant_summary <- function(df, os_col = "oxidative_stress_signature",
                                     nf_col = "TNFA_NFKB_signature") {
          df %>%
            group_by(cell_type) %>%
            mutate(
              os_hi  = !!sym(os_col) >= quantile(!!sym(os_col), q_os_high, na.rm = TRUE),
              nf_lo  = !!sym(nf_col) <= quantile(!!sym(nf_col), q_nf_low,  na.rm = TRUE)
            ) %>%
            summarise(
              n = n(),
              n_hi_lo = sum(os_hi & nf_lo, na.rm = TRUE),
              prop_hi_lo = n_hi_lo / n,
              # 95% CI for the proportion
              ci_low  = prop.test(n_hi_lo, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[1],
              ci_high = prop.test(n_hi_lo, n, correct = FALSE)$conf.int[2],
              # risk ratio comparing high-OS vs low-OS
              p_low_nf_given_high = mean(nf_lo[os_hi], na.rm = TRUE),
              p_low_nf_given_low  = mean(nf_lo[!os_hi], na.rm = TRUE),
              RR = (p_low_nf_given_high) / (p_low_nf_given_low),
              RR_p = fisher.test(table(os_hi, nf_lo))$p.value,
              .groups = "drop"
            )
        }
        
        quad_tbl <- quadrant_summary(scores_df)
        quad_tbl
        
        p <- ggplot(quad_tbl, aes(cell_type, prop_hi_lo)) +
          geom_col() +
          geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = ci_low, ymax = ci_high), width = 0) +
          scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
          labs(y = "High OS & Low NF-κB (percent of cells)", x = NULL) +
          theme_bw(base_size = 14)
        
        ggsave(
          filename =       "/bigdata/bgutman/Collabs/Dror mevorach/scripts/tryp.jpg",

          units    = "in",

        )
        
 
        
      }
      
    }
    
  }
}
```

```{r, "get_meta_table_signature_scores_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways UCELL", eval=FALSE}
get_meta_table_signature_scores_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    vec_path_ids,
    w_neg = 1,
    pct.threshold = 0,
    max_rank = 1500,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE
) {
  # 0) sanity checks
  if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || length(meta_table_list) == 0)
    stop("`meta_table_list` must be a non-empty list of meta tables.")
  needed <- c("meta_table_nk", "meta_table_monocytes", "meta_table_b_cells",
              "meta_table_cd4_t_cells", "meta_table_cd8_t_cells")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(meta_table_list)))
    stop("`meta_table_list` must contain: ",
         paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.character(vec_path_ids) || !length(vec_path_ids))
    stop("`vec_path_ids` must be a non-empty character vector of pathway IDs.")
  
  # 1) list-name -> display-name mapping & desired column order
  cell_name_map <- c(
    meta_table_nk          = "NKs",
    meta_table_monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    meta_table_b_cells     = "B Cells",
    meta_table_cd4_t_cells = "CD4+ T Cells",
    meta_table_cd8_t_cells = "CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  desired_cols <- unname(cell_name_map)
  
  # 2) helper: resolve a pretty pathway name from ID
  get_pathway_name_by_id <- function(path_id, species = "hsa") {
    # KEGG: e.g., hsa04668
    if (grepl(sprintf("^%s\\d{5}$", species), path_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("KEGGREST", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      kg <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(path_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
      nm <- if (!is.null(kg) && !is.null(kg$NAME)) kg$NAME else path_id
      return(as.character(nm))
    }
    # Reactome: e.g., R-HSA-168256
    if (grepl("^R-HSA-\\d+$", path_id)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("reactome.db", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      nm <- tryCatch(reactome.db::reactomePATHID2NAME[[path_id]], error = function(e) NULL)
      return(if (is.null(nm)) path_id else as.character(nm))
    }
    # MSigDB gs_name (any category). Pretty-print if possible.
    nm <- toupper(path_id)
    # Replace underscores with spaces and Title Case for readability
    nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE)
    nm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(nm))
    nm
  }
  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + num_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  num_genes_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vec_path_ids))   # <── new
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_signature_score(
          meta_table     = mt,
          positive_genes = positive_genes,
          negative_genes = NULL,
          pct.threshold  = pct.threshold,
          w_neg          = w_neg,
          max_rank       = max_rank,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}

  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {

    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_signature_score(

      )

    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}
```

```{r, "score with scmetabolisim functions", eval=FALSE}



get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample <- function(
    seu,
    filter_nocoding   = TRUE,
    assay             = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector       = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector   = NULL
) {
  ## ──────────────────────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────
  if (!"final_cell_type" %in% colnames(seu@meta.data))
    stop("Column `final_cell_type` not found in `seu@meta.data`.")
  
  if (is.null(KEGG_vector) && is.null(REACTOME_vector))
    stop("Nothing to compute: both `KEGG_vector` and `REACTOME_vector` are NULL.")
  
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(KEGG_vector))
      stop("`KEGG_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector)) {
    if (!is.character(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` must be a character vector.")
    if (anyDuplicated(REACTOME_vector))
      stop("`REACTOME_vector` contains duplicated pathway names.")
  }
  
  if (!requireNamespace("scMetabolism", quietly = TRUE))
    stop("Package ‘scMetabolism’ (provides sc.metabolism.Seurat) is not installed.")
  
  .barcode_canon <- function(x) {
    x <- gsub("\\.", "-", x, fixed = TRUE)      # dots → dashes
    sub("^[^_]+_", "", x)                      # kill prefix up to first "_"
  }
  
  ## ── 1. grab the SCT ‘corrected counts’ matrix ───────────────────────────
  sct_counts <- GetAssayData(seu, assay = assay, layer = "counts")
  
  ## ── 1a. OPTIONAL: keep only protein-coding genes ────────────────────────
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = rownames(sct_counts),
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ",
              conditionMessage(e), ").")
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(coding_syms)) {
      keep <- intersect(rownames(sct_counts), coding_syms)
      sct_counts <- sct_counts[keep, , drop = FALSE]
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 2. create a legacy RNA assay & set as default ───────────────────────
  seu[["RNA"]]  <- CreateAssayObject(counts = sct_counts)
  DefaultAssay(seu) <- "RNA"
  
  ## ── shared objects for later ────────────────────────────────────────────
  cell_type_vec <- setNames(
    as.character(seu@meta.data$final_cell_type),
    rownames(seu@meta.data)
  )
  cell_types <- sort(setdiff(unique(cell_type_vec), "Other"))  # desired columns
  names(cell_type_vec) <- gsub("-", ".", names(cell_type_vec))
  
  
  ## helper: median per cell-type for a vector of pathways ──────────────────
  median_one_set <- function(seu_obj, pathways) {
    
    mat         <- seu_obj@assays$METABOLISM$score
    cell_names  <- colnames(mat)
    
    lapply(pathways, function(pw) {
      # browser()
      idx <- grep(paste0("^", pw, "$"), rownames(mat), ignore.case = TRUE)
      
      vec <- setNames(rep(NA_real_, length(cell_types)), cell_types)  # default NA
      if (length(idx) == 1) {
        auc <- as.numeric(mat[idx, ])
        names(auc) <- sub("^([^.]+)\\.(.*)\\.(\\d+)$", "\\1-\\2-\\3", cell_names)
        
        names(cell_type_vec) <- {
          fixed <- names(cell_type_vec)
          
          ## 1. unify delimiter ----------------------------------------------------
          ref_delim <- sub(".*([.-])[0-9]+$", "\\1", names(auc)[1])
          tgt_delim <- sub(".*([.-])[0-9]+$", "\\1", fixed[1])
          if (ref_delim != tgt_delim)
            fixed <- gsub(tgt_delim, ref_delim, fixed, fixed = TRUE)
          
          ## 2. (optionally) fix leading “X” ---------------------------------------
          ref_has_X <- startsWith(names(auc)[1], "X")
          
          if (ref_has_X && any(!startsWith(fixed, "X"))) {
            fixed[!startsWith(fixed, "X")] <- paste0("X", fixed[!startsWith(fixed, "X")])
          } else if (!ref_has_X && any(startsWith(fixed, "X"))) {
            fixed[startsWith(fixed, "X")]  <- sub("^X", "", fixed[startsWith(fixed, "X")])
          }
          
          fixed
        }
        
        common <- intersect(names(auc), names(cell_type_vec))
        if (length(common) > 0) {
          med <- tapply(auc[common], cell_type_vec[common], median, na.rm = TRUE)
          vec[names(med)] <- med
        }
      }
      return(vec)
    }) |>
      setNames(pathways)
  }
  
  results_list <- list()
  
  ## ── 3. KEGG block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(KEGG_vector) && length(KEGG_vector) > 0) {
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "KEGG"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, KEGG_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 4. REACTOME block ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.null(REACTOME_vector) && length(REACTOME_vector) > 0) {
    seu@assays$METABOLISM$score <- NULL  # drop prior KEGG scores
    seu <- sc.metabolism.Seurat(
      obj             = seu,
      method          = "AUCell",
      imputation      = FALSE,
      ncores          = 4,
      metabolism.type = "REACTOME"
    )
    results_list <- c(results_list,
                      median_one_set(seu, REACTOME_vector))
  }
  
  ## ── 5. bind into tidy data-frame ────────────────────────────────────────
  path_mat <- do.call(rbind, results_list)               # rbind aligns by names
  med_df   <- as.data.frame(path_mat)
  med_df$pathway <- rownames(med_df)
  med_df <- med_df[, c("pathway", cell_types)]            # order columns
  rownames(med_df) <- NULL
  
  return(med_df)
}



get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset <- function(
    seu_obj,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL
) {
  ## 0. check if the object contains > 1 sample -----------------------------
  multi_sample <- length(unique(seu_obj$sample)) > 1
  
  ## 1. outer list keyed by orig.ident (“Hong”, “Kang”, …) ------------------
  orig_ids <- unique(seu_obj$orig.ident)
  res_out  <- setNames(vector("list", length(orig_ids)), orig_ids)
  
  for (oid in orig_ids) {
    seu_oid   <- subset(seu_obj, subset = orig.ident == oid)
    samp_ids  <- sort(unique(seu_oid$sample))          # HC-1 … HC-n
    
    ## 2. inner list keyed by sample ----------------------------------------
    samp_list <- lapply(samp_ids, function(samp) {
      seu_samp <- subset(seu_oid, subset = sample == samp)
      
      ## optional: rebuild a “clean” Seurat object per sample ---------------
      if (multi_sample) {
        seu_samp <- get_full_seurat(
          seu               = seu_samp,
          compute_cell_cycle = FALSE      # skip CellCycleScoring
        )
      }
      
      get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
        seu             = seu_samp,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        assay           = assay,
        KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
        REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
      )
    })
    names(samp_list) <- samp_ids
    res_out[[oid]]   <- samp_list
  }
  
  return(res_out)
}





get_scMetab_log2fc_barplot <- function(
    controls_medians = NULL,
    seu_patient,
    healthy_list,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE,
    assay           = "SCT",
    KEGG_vector     = NULL,
    REACTOME_vector = NULL,
    title              = "Ox-stress pathways (patient vs. controls)",
    my_pathway_cols    = c("Glutathione metabolism" = "#fb8500",
                           "Oxidative phosphorylation" = "#219ebc"),
    title_size        = 12,
    y_title_size      = 12,
    y_text_size       = 12,
    mat_row_text_size = 12,
    legend_title_size = 12,
    legend_text_size  = 12,
    base_size         = 12) {
  ## ── 0 · sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    if (!is.list(healthy_list) || length(healthy_list) == 0)
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a non-empty *list* of Seurat objects.")
    
    if (is.null(names(healthy_list)) || any(names(healthy_list) == ""))
      stop("`healthy_list` must be a *named* list (e.g. names like 'seu_cd55').")
    
    if (anyDuplicated(names(healthy_list)))
      stop("`healthy_list` contains duplicated names: ",
           paste(unique(names(healthy_list)[duplicated(names(healthy_list))]),
                 collapse = ", "))
    
    not_seurat <- !vapply(healthy_list, inherits, logical(1), what = "Seurat")
    if (any(not_seurat))
      stop("All elements of `healthy_list` must be Seurat objects. ",
           "Problems at positions: ", paste(which(not_seurat), collapse = ", "))
    
  } else {
    if (!is.list(controls_medians) || length(controls_medians) == 0)
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a non-empty list produced by ",
           "`get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset()`.")
    if (is.null(names(controls_medians)) || any(names(controls_medians) == ""))
      stop("`controls_medians` must be a *named* list.")
    
    bad <- vapply(controls_medians, function(donor_list) {
      # each donor_list should be a non-empty list of data.frames with a "pathway" column
      if (!is.list(donor_list) || length(donor_list) == 0) return(TRUE)
      !all(vapply(donor_list, function(df) {
        is.data.frame(df) && "pathway" %in% colnames(df)
      }, logical(1)))
    }, logical(1))
    
    if (any(bad)) {
      stop("`controls_medians` has unexpected structure at positions: ",
           paste(which(bad), collapse = ", "))
    }
  }
  
  
  ## ── 1 · patient medians ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  patient_medians <- get_celltype_scmetabolisim_median_for_one_sample(
    seu             = seu_patient,
    filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
    assay           = assay,
    KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
    REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
  )
  
  ## ── 2 · controls (compute only if not supplied) ──────────────────────────
  if (is.null(controls_medians)) {
    controls_medians <- lapply(healthy_list, function(seu_obj) {
      print(seu_obj@meta.data$orig.ident)
      get_scMetab_medians_by_dataset(
        seu_obj         = seu_obj,
        filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding,
        assay           = assay,
        KEGG_vector     = KEGG_vector,
        REACTOME_vector = REACTOME_vector
      )
    })
    names(controls_medians) <- names(healthy_list)
    
    control_medians <- controls_medians
    
    ## ── 3 · flatten & merge by dataset ───────────────────────────────────────
    {
      dataset_lists  <- lapply(control_medians, function(x) x[[1]])
      dataset_names  <- sapply(control_medians, function(x) names(x)[1])
      merged <- list()
      for (i in seq_along(dataset_lists)) {
        ds <- dataset_names[i]
        if (!ds %in% names(merged)) {
          merged[[ds]] <- dataset_lists[[i]]
        } else {
          merged[[ds]] <- c(merged[[ds]], dataset_lists[[i]])
        }
      }
      control_medians <- merged
    }
    
    
  } else{
    control_medians <- controls_medians
    
  }
  
  
  
  ## ── 4 · calculate controls medians ───────────────────────────────────────
  {
    sample_list <- do.call(c, control_medians)
    pathways    <- sample_list[[1]]$pathway
    cell_types  <- setdiff(names(sample_list[[1]]), "pathway")
    
    control_medians_df <- data.frame(pathway = pathways, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      mat <- sapply(sample_list, `[[`, ct)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_median")]] <- apply(mat, 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
      control_medians_df[[paste0(ct, "_nNA")]]    <- apply(mat, 1, function(x) sum(is.na(x)))
    }
  }
  
  ## ── 5 · calculate log2FC ─────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    clean_pathway <- function(x) {
      x <- trimws(x)
      x <- gsub("([A-Za-z0-9])\\.([A-Za-z0-9])", "\\1 \\2", x)  # word.word -> word word
      x
    }
    patient_medians$pathway    <- clean_pathway(patient_medians$pathway)
    control_medians_df$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_medians_df$pathway)
    
    fc_df <- merge(
      patient_medians,
      control_medians_df,
      by       = "pathway",
      suffixes = c("_patient", "_control")
    )
    
    cell_types <- c("B cells", "CD4+ T cells", "CD8+ T cells", "Monocytes", "NK cells")
    for (ct in cell_types) {
      pat_col  <- ct
      ctrl_col <- paste0(ct, "_median")
      out_col  <- paste0(ct, "_log2FC")
      fc_df[[out_col]] <- log2((fc_df[[pat_col]] + 1e-6) / (fc_df[[ctrl_col]] + 1e-6))
    }
    log2fc_only <- fc_df[, c("pathway", paste0(cell_types, "_log2FC"))]
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(
        cols = tidyselect::ends_with("_log2FC"),
        names_to  = "cell_type",
        values_to = "log2FC"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(
        cell_type = sub("_log2FC$", "", cell_type),
        cell_type = gsub("\\.+", " ", cell_type)
      )
  }
  
  ## ── 6 · CIs and q value ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    patient_long <- patient_medians %>%
      tidyr::pivot_longer(-pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "patient_median")
    
    control_long <- purrr::imap_dfr(control_medians, function(dataset_list, dataset) {
      purrr::imap_dfr(dataset_list, function(sample_df, sample_id) {
        sample_df %>%
          tidyr::pivot_longer(cols = -pathway, names_to = "cell_type", values_to = "control_median") %>%
          dplyr::mutate(dataset = dataset, sample_id = sample_id)
      })
    })
    
    patient_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(patient_long$pathway)
    control_long$pathway <- clean_pathway(control_long$pathway)
    
    merged <- patient_long %>%
      dplyr::inner_join(control_long, by = c("pathway", "cell_type")) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(log2fc_each = log2(patient_median / control_median))
    
    summary_df <- merged %>%
      dplyr::group_by(pathway, cell_type) %>%
      dplyr::summarise(
        log2FC    = mean(log2fc_each),
        se        = stats::sd(log2fc_each) / sqrt(dplyr::n()),
        t95       = stats::qt(0.975, df = dplyr::n() - 1),
        CI_top    = log2FC +  t95 * se,
        CI_bottom = log2FC -  t95 * se,
        p_val     = stats::t.test(log2fc_each, mu = 0)$p.value,
        .groups   = "drop"
      ) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(q_val = p.adjust(p_val, method = "BH"))
    
    log2fc_only <- log2fc_only %>%
      dplyr::left_join(summary_df %>% 
                         dplyr::select(pathway, cell_type, CI_top, CI_bottom, q_val),
                       by = c("pathway", "cell_type"))
  }
  
  ## ── 7 · barplot ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
  {
    pdat <- log2fc_only
    
    order_vec <- pdat %>%
      dplyr::filter(pathway == "Glutathione metabolism") %>% 
      dplyr::arrange(dplyr::desc(log2FC)) %>% 
      dplyr::pull(cell_type)
    
    pdat <- pdat %>% 
      dplyr::mutate(cell_type = factor(cell_type, levels = order_vec))
    
    ## FIX 1: keep only pathways we color, then lock factor levels to mapping
    pdat <- pdat %>%
      dplyr::filter(pathway %in% names(my_pathway_cols)) %>%     # <- FIX
      dplyr::mutate(pathway = factor(pathway,                    # <- FIX
                                     levels = names(my_pathway_cols)))
    
    pdodge <- ggplot2::position_dodge(width = 0.65)
    
    p_bar <- ggplot2::ggplot(
      pdat,
      ggplot2::aes(x = cell_type, y = log2FC, fill = pathway)
    ) +
      ggplot2::geom_col(width = 0.6, position = pdodge) +
      ggplot2::geom_errorbar(
        ggplot2::aes(ymin = CI_bottom, ymax = CI_top),
        width = 0.4, position = pdodge, linewidth = 0.4
      ) +
      ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, linetype = "dashed") +
      ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
        values = my_pathway_cols,
        breaks = names(my_pathway_cols),                                   # <- FIX
        labels = stringr::str_to_title(names(my_pathway_cols)),
        name   = "Pathway"
      ) +
      ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
        limits = c(-0.5, 1),
        breaks = seq(-1, 1, by = 0.5),
        expand = ggplot2::expansion(mult = 0)
      ) +
      ggplot2::labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = expression(log[2] * " EF"),
        title = title
      ) +
      ggplot2::coord_cartesian(clip = "off") +
      ggplot2::theme_minimal(base_size = base_size) +
      ggplot2::theme(
        plot.title         = ggplot2::element_text(hjust = 0.5, face = "bold", size = title_size),
        axis.title.y       = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_title_size),
        axis.text.y        = ggplot2::element_text(size = y_text_size),
        axis.text.x        = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = y_text_size),
        axis.ticks.x       = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        legend.title       = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_title_size),
        legend.text        = ggplot2::element_text(size = legend_text_size),
        panel.grid.major.x = ggplot2::element_blank(),
        panel.grid.minor   = ggplot2::element_blank()
      )
  }
  
  list(
    control_medians = control_medians,
    log2fc_df       = log2fc_only,
    p_bar           = p_bar
  )
}
```

```{r, "old auc functions: with padding", eval=FALSE}

get_meta_table_auc_score <- function(meta_table,
                                     positive_genes,
                                     filter_nocoding = TRUE) {
  ## 0 ·──────── sanity checks ────────────────────────────────────────────────
  if (!is.data.frame(meta_table))
    stop("`meta_table` must be a data-frame.")
  
  if (is.null(rownames(meta_table))) {
    if (!"gene" %in% colnames(meta_table))
      stop("`meta_table` must have gene symbols as row names or a 'gene' column.")
    rownames(meta_table) <- as.character(meta_table$gene)
  }
  
  if (!"median_log2FC" %in% colnames(meta_table))
    stop("`meta_table` is missing required column: 'median_log2FC'.")
  
  if (missing(positive_genes) || length(positive_genes) == 0)
    stop("`positive_genes` must be a non-empty character vector.")
  
  ## 1 ·──────── optional: filter to protein-coding genes ─────────────────────
  if (isTRUE(filter_nocoding)) {
    coding_syms <- tryCatch({
      if (!requireNamespace("biomaRt", quietly = TRUE))
        stop("Package 'biomaRt' not installed.")
      mart  <- biomaRt::useEnsembl("genes", dataset = "hsapiens_gene_ensembl")
      annot <- biomaRt::getBM(
        attributes = c("hgnc_symbol", "gene_biotype"),
        filters    = "hgnc_symbol",
        values     = unique(rownames(meta_table)),
        mart       = mart
      )
      unique(annot$hgnc_symbol[annot$gene_biotype == "protein_coding"])
    }, error = function(e) {
      warning("Protein-coding filter skipped (biomaRt error: ",
              conditionMessage(e), ").")
      NULL
    })
    if (!is.null(coding_syms))
      meta_table <- meta_table[rownames(meta_table) %in% coding_syms, , drop = FALSE]
  }
  
  ## 2 ·──────── assemble the gene universe and pad missing ───────────────────
  positive_genes <- unique(positive_genes)
  universe <- unique(c(rownames(meta_table), positive_genes))
  
  missing_genes <- setdiff(universe, rownames(meta_table))
  if (length(missing_genes)) {
    pad <- as.data.frame(matrix(0, nrow = length(missing_genes), ncol = ncol(meta_table)))
    colnames(pad) <- colnames(meta_table)
    rownames(pad) <- missing_genes
    if ("gene" %in% colnames(pad)) pad$gene <- missing_genes
    # ensure missing positives get the worst possible score
    if ("median_log2FC" %in% colnames(pad)) pad$median_log2FC <- -Inf
    meta_table <- rbind(meta_table, pad)
  }
  
  ## 3 ·──────── prepare the score vector (median_log2FC) ─────────────────────
  logfc_vec <- meta_table$median_log2FC
  names(logfc_vec) <- rownames(meta_table)
  
  # drop NAs in the scoring metric
  logfc_vec <- logfc_vec[!is.na(logfc_vec)]
  
  pos <- intersect(positive_genes, names(logfc_vec))
  if (!length(pos)) {
    warning("None of the `positive_genes` are present after filtering; returning NA.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  neg <- setdiff(names(logfc_vec), pos)
  if (!length(neg)) {
    warning("Background set is empty; returning NA.")
    return(NA_real_)
  }
  
  ## 4 ·──────── compute AUC via Mann–Whitney/Wilcoxon equivalence ────────────
  # rank() gives ascending ranks; higher logFC -> larger rank → larger AUC
  r <- rank(logfc_vec, ties.method = "average")
  L <- length(pos)
  N <- length(logfc_vec)
  sum_r_pos <- sum(r[pos])
  U <- sum_r_pos - L * (L + 1) / 2
  auc <- U / (L * length(neg))
  
  # clamp to [0,1] in case of tiny numerical wobble
  auc <- max(0, min(1, auc))
  return(auc)
}


get_meta_table_auc_score_for_many_cell_types_and_pathways <- function(
    meta_table_list,
    vec_path_ids,
    filter_nocoding = TRUE
) {
  # 0) sanity checks
  if (!is.list(meta_table_list) || length(meta_table_list) == 0)
    stop("`meta_table_list` must be a non-empty list of meta tables.")
  needed <- c("meta_table_nk", "meta_table_monocytes", "meta_table_b_cells",
              "meta_table_cd4_t_cells", "meta_table_cd8_t_cells")
  if (!all(needed %in% names(meta_table_list)))
    stop("`meta_table_list` must contain: ",
         paste(needed, collapse = ", "))
  if (!is.character(vec_path_ids) || !length(vec_path_ids))
    stop("`vec_path_ids` must be a non-empty character vector of pathway IDs.")
  
  # 1) list-name -> display-name mapping & desired column order
  cell_name_map <- c(
    meta_table_nk          = "NKs",
    meta_table_monocytes   = "Monocytes",
    meta_table_b_cells     = "B Cells",
    meta_table_cd4_t_cells = "CD4+ T Cells",
    meta_table_cd8_t_cells = "CD8+ T Cells"
  )
  desired_cols <- unname(cell_name_map)
  
  # 2) helper: resolve a pretty pathway name from ID
  get_pathway_name_by_id <- function(path_id, species = "hsa") {
    # KEGG: e.g., hsa04668
    if (grepl(sprintf("^%s\\d{5}$", species), path_id, ignore.case = TRUE)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("KEGGREST", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("KEGGREST", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      kg <- tryCatch(KEGGREST::keggGet(path_id)[[1]], error = function(e) NULL)
      nm <- if (!is.null(kg) && !is.null(kg$NAME)) kg$NAME else path_id
      return(as.character(nm))
    }
    # Reactome: e.g., R-HSA-168256
    if (grepl("^R-HSA-\\d+$", path_id)) {
      if (!requireNamespace("reactome.db", quietly = TRUE)) {
        if (!requireNamespace("BiocManager", quietly = TRUE)) install.packages("BiocManager")
        BiocManager::install("reactome.db", ask = FALSE, update = FALSE)
      }
      nm <- tryCatch(reactome.db::reactomePATHID2NAME[[path_id]], error = function(e) NULL)
      return(if (is.null(nm)) path_id else as.character(nm))
    }
    # MSigDB gs_name (any category). Pretty-print if possible.
    nm <- toupper(path_id)
    # Replace underscores with spaces and Title Case for readability
    nm <- gsub("_", " ", nm, fixed = TRUE)
    nm <- tools::toTitleCase(tolower(nm))
    nm
  }
  # 3) prepare result container: rows = pathways, cols = cell types + num_genes
  path_names <- vapply(vec_path_ids, get_pathway_name_by_id, character(1))
  res <- matrix(NA_real_, nrow = length(vec_path_ids), ncol = length(desired_cols),
                dimnames = list(path_names, desired_cols))
  num_genes_vec <- rep(NA_integer_, length(vec_path_ids))   # <── new
  
  # 4) loop over pathways
  for (i in seq_along(vec_path_ids)) {
    pid <- vec_path_ids[i]
    
    positive_genes <- tryCatch(get_pathway_genes_by_id(pid), error = function(e) character())
    if (!length(positive_genes)) next
    
    num_genes_vec[i] <- length(positive_genes)   # <── new
    
    for (nm in names(cell_name_map)) {
      display <- cell_name_map[[nm]]
      mt <- meta_table_list[[nm]]
      score <- tryCatch(
        get_meta_table_auc_score(
          meta_table     = mt,
          positive_genes = positive_genes,
          filter_nocoding = filter_nocoding
        ),
        error = function(e) NA_real_
      )
      res[i, display] <- score
    }
  }
  
  # 5) return as data.frame with num_genes column
  df <- as.data.frame(res, check.names = FALSE, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  df$num_genes <- num_genes_vec
  df
}
```
